method: Race-level estimates apply national survey rates to each state's registered-voter count: 43% of registered voters support MAHA and 56% of those are MAGA Republicans (KFF, Apr 14–19, 2026), so about 18.9% of registered voters support MAHA without being MAGA. National rates will overstate the bloc in blue states and understate it in rural red states; treat the counts as order-of-magnitude, not forecasts. Margins are the 2024 presidential result and the most recent comparable statewide race in 2022; the midterm drop-off is votes cast in 2024 minus votes cast in 2022, the pool of occasional voters whose turnout decides a midterm.

checklist.intro: The House Democrats' 'Reclaiming MAHA' memo attaches these items to a Democratic first year. For each: has the administration or a Republican delivered something concrete, and has a Democrat campaigned on it? Rows with no concrete delivery before Nov 3 are the openings being handed to the other side. State-level bill status is outside this table; MAHA Action's legislative tracker (https://www.mahaaction.org) covers it.

legend.reversed: Federal action in the opposite direction

rows.item: Glyphosate liability (No Immunity for Glyphosate Act, Massie–Pingree)
rows.admin: Feb 18, 2026 executive order declares glyphosate critical to national defense and orders prioritized domestic production; June 2026 Supreme Court ruling (7–2, administration siding with Bayer) blocks most state failure-to-warn suits.
rows.dem: Memo's first 100-hours item; Pingree co-lead. Sharpest intra-movement backlash of the cycle.

rows.admin: FDA proposed rule Aug 10, 2026 to require GRAS notices for all new substances (docket FDA-2025-N-3262). Proposed, not final; no comment deadline posted.
rows.dem: 100-days item. Finalizing before Nov 3 would remove it from the Democratic list.

rows.item: Baby-food heavy metals (Baby Food Safety Act, Krishnamoorthi)
rows.admin: FDA 'Closer to Zero' action levels for lead in processed baby food (Jan 2025 guidance, 10–20 ppb); Apr 29, 2026 formula contaminant testing results. Guidance, not enforceable limits.
rows.dem: 100-hours item: enforceable federal limits and recall authority.

rows.item: Infant formula safety (Infant Formula Safety Modernization Act, DeLauro)
rows.admin: Operation Stork Speed (Mar 18, 2025): first nutrient-requirement review in decades, increased contaminant testing, Jul 13, 2026 letter to manufacturers. Administrative, not statutory.
rows.dem: 100-hours item: mandatory contamination detection and reporting.

rows.item: Synthetic dyes out of school meals (national standard)
rows.admin: Red No. 3 revoked Jan 15, 2025 (compliance Jan 15, 2027); Orange B revoked effective Sep 8, 2026; six remaining dyes targeted for end-2027 by voluntary industry pledges (General Mills K-12 by summer 2026). No federal school-meal standard; states acting individually.
rows.dem: First-year item: national dye-free school-meal standard so every child is covered, 'not just those in states that have acted'.

rows.admin: FDA proposed rule Jan 2025; final rule listed for Dec 2026 on FDA's regulatory agenda. Not final.

rows.item: Pesticide bans (Protect America's Children from Toxic Pesticides Act, McGovern)
rows.admin: Sep 9, 2025 MAHA Strategy 'leaves pesticides alone'; EPA approved five PFAS-class pesticide active ingredients Nov 2025 – Jul 2026; USDA rescinded pesticide recordkeeping rules Jun 2025. EPA finalized paraquat safety measures Feb 2026.
rows.dem: First-year item. Second-largest intra-movement grievance after glyphosate.

rows.item: Food-packaging chemicals (No Toxic Chemicals in Food Packaging Act, Schakowsky)
rows.admin: PFAS grease-proofing agents off the market since Feb 2024 (pre-dates MAHA); Jan 2025 Federal Register notice. No new action on other packaging chemicals.

rows.item: Food is Medicine / produce prescriptions (FOOD for Health Act, Kelly–Kiggans; Ruiz)
rows.admin: Indian Health Service $3.5M Produce Prescription Pilot awards (Sep 22, 2026); no department-wide program or appropriation request.

rows.item: Healthier school meals (Local Foods for Healthy Schools; Scratch Cooked Meals)
rows.admin: Dietary Guidelines 2025–2030 (Jan 2026) 'Eat Real Food'; USDA encourages state standards; federal ultra-processed-food definition still pending after Jul 2025 RFI (5,000+ comments).

rows.item: Supplement registration (Dietary Supplement Listing Act, Dexter / Durbin)
rows.admin: No administration position; the movement's supplement wing opposes mandatory listing.
rows.dem: 100-days item. A point where the Democratic list diverges from part of the MAHA base.

rows.item: Permanent EPA Office of Children's Health Protection (Nadler)
rows.admin: Office reorganized in 2025 into a 'Children's Health Protection Division' inside a new Office of Applied Science; EPA told advocates Dec 3, 2025 programs continue subject to appropriations. Not statutory.
rows.dem: 100-days item: make the office permanent in law.
